results.title: SoloOp | Free App for Solo Tradies — Scheduling, Invoicing, Payments
results.content:
Client directory — searchable A–Z list with archive and restore
 Import from contacts — pull name, phone, email from your phone
 Google Places autocomplete — geocoded for smart scheduling
 Recurring jobs — weekly, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly, and more — auto-generates
 WhatsApp sharing — share invoices and confirmations in one tap
 Declined card alerts — Stripe detects the failure, emails you the reason
 Money owed banner — persistent total of outstanding invoices on home screen
 Branded receipts — automatic receipt email when clients pay
 Short payment links — SMS-friendly URLs for payment pages
 Booking confirmations — branded emails with ETA, service type, and your phone number
 Mark paid / void — cash or bank transfer? Just mark it, no fee [...] ## Invoice on the driveway

Mark the job done. Confirm the price. Send via email, SMS, or WhatsApp — three taps. Branded invoice with your logo, ABN, and GST breakdown. Automatic reminders if they don't pay.

### AutoPay — they approve once

Client approves once via PayTo (bank-to-bank direct debit) or card on file. Finish the job, tap charge, money moves. No invoice. No reminder. Bank payments: 1% + $1.30. Card: 1.75% + $1.30. All capped at $19.95.

## Works behind the Colorbond fence

No signal? Doesn't matter. Mark jobs done, add clients, check your run — everything queues and syncs when you're back on the road. Bush Journal lets you jot down job details offline and convert them later.

## Rain Mode — one tap, sorted

Three strategies for wet weather, breakdowns, or emergencies: [...] Push Back — bumps everything 24 hours, cascades until jobs fit.
 Smart — distributes jobs across the week, grouped by area, respects daily limits.
 Bucket — parks jobs for manual recovery later.

One more tap sends branded emails to all affected clients with their new date.

## End of day — wrap it up in 60 seconds

What you earned (with progress bar against your daily goal), uninvoiced jobs, overdue invoices with one-tap nudge, and tomorrow's run with confirmation status. Then tap "Head Home" — opens your home address in Google Maps.

## Tax time — four taps, CSV, done

Every payment tracked, expenses recorded with GST. Financial year summary, quarterly breakdowns, BAS-ready. CSV export: date, client, service, subtotal, GST, total, fee, net. Separate expense export.
